title: When the Rain Cleared the Sky
content:
The night had grown quiet.

A cool breeze drifted through the balcony of Yashwanth's house.

Unable to sleep...

Siddu slowly walked outside.

He rested both his hands on the railing and looked up at the sky.

Dark clouds had swallowed the moon.

The entire sky was covered in darkness.

He stood there silently...

Lost in thought.

Just then...

A gentle drizzle began to fall.

As the rain continued, the cool evening breeze slowly pushed the dark clouds aside.

Little by little...

The moon emerged from behind them, spreading its silver light across the night sky.

Siddu watched the sky quietly.

For some reason...

It reminded him of his own heart.

The darkness inside him...

The pain he had been carrying for years...

Slowly, one memory after another began to surface.

The day they had first travelled together in the car...

The unforgettable moments they had shared in Shimla...

The peaceful memories of Dagshai...

Their beautiful journey through Mussoorie...

And...

That unforgettable moment...

When he had almost kissed Sneha.

Every memory brought a smile to his face.

The more he remembered...

The lighter his heart became.

Just as the rain had cleared the darkness from the sky...

Those precious memories slowly washed away the sadness buried deep within his heart.

He closed his eyes.

Took a deep breath.

Then finally...

He reached a decision.

"No matter what happened between us..."

"She deserves to be there."

"I'll invite her myself."

Without another thought...

He took out his phone.

Found Sneha's number.

And pressed the call button.

________________________________________

Meanwhile...

Sneha sat quietly on a park bench, her eyes fixed on the glowing moon above.

The peaceful night did little to calm the storm inside her heart.

Just then...

Her phone began to ring.

Without looking at the caller's name...

She answered absentmindedly.

"Hello..."

"Who is this?"

A familiar voice came from the other end.

"Hello..."

"This is Siddhartha."

The moment she heard that voice...

Her entire body froze.

Her heart skipped a beat.

Slowly...

She lowered the phone and looked at the caller's name.

Siddu.

Her eyes widened in disbelief.

Unable to believe what she was seeing...

She gently pinched herself.

"This..."

"This is real...?"

She immediately lifted the phone back to her ear.

"Is..."

"Is this really you?"

A gentle smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"Yes."

That single word was enough.

A smile spread across Sneha's face.

Her eyes slowly filled with tears.

Five years...

It had been five long years since they had last spoken.

Neither of them knew where to begin.

Finally...

Siddu broke the silence.

"It's been a long time..."

Sneha smiled through her tears.

"Yes..."

"A lot has changed."

She paused for a moment before continuing.

"Now you're one of the most well-known people in France..."

"And even in India."

Siddu let out a soft laugh.

"I may have become famous..."

"But to you..."

"I'm still the same old Siddu..."

"The friend who met you..."

"And slowly became..."

His voice stopped.

The words refused to leave his lips.

On the other end of the call...

Sneha slowly closed her eyes.

"Say it..."

"Please..."

"Just once..."

"Tell me what your heart still wants to say."

Siddu took a deep breath.

He cleared his throat.

But instead of completing the sentence...

He forced a smile.

"Forget it."

"I actually called to invite you."

"Yashwanth is getting married."

"I want you to come."

For a brief moment...

Sneha remained silent.

She understood.

He still wasn't ready to open his heart.

A faint smile appeared on her face.

"Is that so?"

"Then..."

"I'll definitely come."

Relief spread across Siddu's face.

"I'm glad."

"Then..."

"I'll see you at the wedding."

"Okay..."

"Bye, Sneha."

She held the phone a little tighter.

"It's been..."

"Really nice talking to you again."

Siddu smiled softly.

"It was nice talking to you too."

For a few seconds...

Neither of them disconnected the call.

Neither wanted the conversation to end.

Finally...

The call ended.

Siddu remained standing quietly on the balcony, gazing at the moon that had finally emerged from behind the clouds.

Not far away...

Sneha remained seated on the park bench, looking at the very same moon with a gentle smile.

For the first time in five long years...

The distance between their hearts no longer felt impossible.

Perhaps...

This was how fate quietly began bringing them back to each other.
